Worth to try!!
Jun 2026 • Family
We had a wonderful dinner here during our stay in Cát Bà. The seafood was fresh and delicious, and the braised fish was perfectly seasoned with a rich, comforting flavor.

Our children ordered the spaghetti and creamy shrimp, and they absolutely loved them—they finished every bite, which is always a great sign! The food was tasty, family-friendly, and beautifully prepared.

The staff were welcoming and attentive, and the atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable. We left very satisfied and would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Cát Bà.
